note: 每日一诵：内置短文，按日期轮换。英文原文为学习材料，中文为参考译文。

sentences.en: Most people try to change their lives in one big step.
sentences.zh: 大多数人想用一大步改变自己的生活。

sentences.en: They decide to run ten kilometers or read a whole book in a week.
sentences.zh: 他们决定一周跑十公里，或者读完一整本书。

sentences.en: A few days later, the plan is too heavy, and they stop.
sentences.zh: 几天之后，计划太重，他们就停了。

sentences.en: Small habits work better because they are easy to repeat.
sentences.zh: 小习惯更有效，因为它们容易重复。

sentences.en: Ten minutes of reading every night can become a lifetime of learning.
sentences.zh: 每晚读十分钟，可能变成一辈子的学习。

sentences.en: The secret is not a big start, but a small step you can keep.
sentences.zh: 秘诀不在于宏大的开始，而在于你能坚持的一小步。

sentences.en: Students often study late into the night before an exam.
sentences.zh: 考试前，学生们常常学到深夜。

sentences.en: They believe that more hours mean more knowledge.
sentences.zh: 他们相信时间越多，知识就越多。

sentences.en: But the brain needs sleep to store what we learn during the day.
sentences.zh: 但大脑需要睡眠来储存白天学到的东西。

sentences.en: During deep sleep, the brain sorts new information and connects it with old memories.
sentences.zh: 在深度睡眠中，大脑整理新信息，并把它和旧记忆连接起来。

sentences.en: So a good night's sleep may help you more than one more hour of reading.
sentences.zh: 所以，睡个好觉可能比多读一小时更有帮助。

sentences.en: Rest is part of learning, not a waste of time.
sentences.zh: 休息是学习的一部分，而不是浪费时间。

sentences.en: Many of us say we are too busy to read.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人说自己太忙，没时间读书。

sentences.en: Yet we often spend an hour a day looking at short videos.
sentences.zh: 然而我们常常每天花一小时刷短视频。

sentences.en: Reading a book is slower, and that is exactly why it is useful.
sentences.zh: 读书更慢，而这恰恰是它有用的原因。

sentences.en: A long story teaches us to follow an idea and to feel with other people.
sentences.zh: 一个长故事教会我们追随一个想法，并与人共情。

sentences.en: Try carrying a small book and reading two pages while you wait.
sentences.zh: 试着带一本小书，等待时读两页。

sentences.en: Those two pages can quietly change a busy day.
sentences.zh: 这两页可能悄悄地改变忙碌的一天。

sentences.en: Artificial intelligence is no longer only a topic in science fiction.
sentences.zh: 人工智能不再只是科幻小说里的主题。

sentences.en: It helps doctors read pictures and helps students practice languages.
sentences.zh: 它帮助医生读片，也帮助学生练习语言。

sentences.en: The tool itself is neither good nor bad; the use decides the result.
sentences.zh: 工具本身无所谓好坏，怎么用才决定结果。

sentences.en: A useful habit is to ask who made the answer and what evidence supports it.
sentences.zh: 一个有用的习惯是问：这个答案是谁给的？有什么证据支持它？

sentences.en: Machines can save us time, but we still have to think for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 机器能为我们省时间，但我们仍然要自己思考。

sentences.en: The future belongs to people who can ask better questions.
sentences.zh: 未来属于那些能提出更好问题的人。

sentences.en: A city street without trees can be ten degrees hotter in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天，没有树的城市街道可能热上十度。

sentences.en: Trees give shade, clean the air, and make people feel calmer.
sentences.zh: 树木提供树荫、净化空气，也让人感到更平静。

sentences.en: Some neighborhoods, however, have far fewer trees than others.
sentences.zh: 然而，有些社区拥有的树远少于其他社区。

sentences.en: This difference is not only about beauty; it is about health.
sentences.zh: 这种差别不仅关乎美观，更关乎健康。

sentences.en: Planting a tree is a gift to people you will never meet.
sentences.zh: 种一棵树，是送给素未谋面之人的礼物。

sentences.en: Good cities are built for the next generation, not only for today.
sentences.zh: 好的城市是为下一代建造的，而不只是为了今天。

sentences.en: Many people study grammar for years and still cannot speak.
sentences.zh: 许多人学了好几年语法，却仍然开不了口。

sentences.en: The problem is that they never use the language to say anything real.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，他们从不用这门语言说任何真实的话。

sentences.en: A better way is to read and listen a little every day, then repeat what you hear.
sentences.zh: 更好的办法是每天读一点、听一点，然后重复你听到的内容。

sentences.en: Mistakes are not a sign of failure; they are part of the process.
sentences.zh: 犯错不是失败的标志，而是过程的一部分。

sentences.en: If you can explain your breakfast in English, you are already learning.
sentences.zh: 如果你能用英语讲清自己的早餐，你已经在学了。

sentences.en: Languages are built by using them, not by memorizing rules.
sentences.zh: 语言是靠使用建立起来的，而不是靠背规则。

passages.title: A Cup of Coffee and a Pause

sentences.en: For millions of people, the day does not begin until the first cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 对数百万人来说，喝下第一杯咖啡，一天才算开始。

sentences.en: Coffee shops have become places to meet, work, and think.
sentences.zh: 咖啡馆成了见面、工作和思考的地方。

sentences.en: Some studies suggest that a little coffee may be good for the heart.
sentences.zh: 一些研究表明，少量咖啡可能对心脏有好处。

sentences.en: But too much coffee can make it hard to sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 但喝太多咖啡会让人夜里难以入睡。

sentences.en: Perhaps the real value of coffee is the pause it creates in a busy day.
sentences.zh: 也许咖啡真正的价值，是它在忙碌的一天里创造出的停顿。

sentences.en: A short pause can help us see what really matters.
sentences.zh: 短暂的停顿能帮我们看清什么才重要。

passages.title: Moving Your Body, Changing Your Mood

sentences.en: When we feel tired, we usually sit down and rest.
sentences.zh: 觉得累的时候，我们通常会坐下休息。

sentences.en: But sometimes the best rest is a slow walk outside.
sentences.zh: 但有时最好的休息，是在户外慢慢走一走。

sentences.en: Exercise sends more blood to the brain and reduces stress.
sentences.zh: 运动让更多血液流向大脑，并减轻压力。

sentences.en: You do not need a gym; stairs, streets, and parks are enough.
sentences.zh: 你不需要健身房；楼梯、街道和公园就够了。

sentences.en: Twenty minutes of movement can change the rest of your day.
sentences.zh: 二十分钟的活动，能改变你这一天的后半段。

sentences.en: The body and the mind are not two separate things.
sentences.zh: 身体和头脑并不是两件分开的事。

passages.title: The True Price of Fast Fashion

sentences.en: A T-shirt that costs less than a coffee seems like a bargain.
sentences.zh: 一件比咖啡还便宜的 T 恤，看起来像是捡了便宜。

sentences.en: But someone has to grow the cotton, cut the cloth, and sew it.
sentences.zh: 但总得有人种棉花、裁布料、把它缝起来。

sentences.en: When prices are very low, the cost often falls on the environment or on workers.
sentences.zh: 价格极低时，代价往往落在环境或工人身上。

sentences.en: Buying fewer clothes and wearing them longer is one simple answer.
sentences.zh: 少买衣服、多穿几年，就是一个简单的答案。

sentences.en: We do not need to be perfect; we only need to ask one more question before we buy.
sentences.zh: 我们不必做到完美，只需在买之前多问一个问题。

sentences.en: Cheap can be expensive in ways we do not see.
sentences.zh: 便宜，可能以我们看不见的方式变得昂贵。

sentences.en: When you look at the stars, you are looking back in time.
sentences.zh: 当你仰望星空时，你看到的是过去的时光。

sentences.en: Light from the nearest star takes more than four years to reach us.
sentences.zh: 最近一颗恒星的光，要四年多才能到达我们这里。

sentences.en: Powerful telescopes can see light that left its source billions of years ago.
sentences.zh: 强大的望远镜能看到数十亿年前离开源头的光。

sentences.en: In this way, astronomers study the childhood of the universe.
sentences.zh: 天文学家就这样研究宇宙的童年。

sentences.en: Every new picture brings more questions than answers.
sentences.zh: 每一张新照片带来的问题，都比答案多。

sentences.en: Science is a long conversation with the unknown.
sentences.zh: 科学是一场与未知的漫长对话。

sentences.en: As children, we make friends simply by playing together.
sentences.zh: 小时候，我们一起玩就交上了朋友。

sentences.en: As adults, we often wait for friendship to happen by itself.
sentences.zh: 成年后，我们常常等着友谊自己发生。

sentences.en: But friendship needs repeated small moments: a walk, a message, a shared meal.
sentences.zh: 但友谊需要一次次微小的时刻：一次散步、一条消息、一顿一起吃的饭。

sentences.en: It is easy to be busy and hard to be present.
sentences.zh: 忙碌很容易，陪伴却很难。

sentences.en: Call one person you have not spoken to for a while.
sentences.zh: 给一位很久没联系的人打个电话。

sentences.en: Most people are happy to hear from someone who remembers them.
sentences.zh: 大多数人接到记得自己的人的问候，都会很开心。

sentences.en: Saving money feels impossible when the month is short and the bills are many.
sentences.zh: 月底钱紧、账单又多的时候，存钱显得不可能。

sentences.en: Yet many people save by moving a small amount on payday, before they spend anything.
sentences.zh: 但很多人会在发薪日先转出一小笔，再开始花钱。

sentences.en: The amount matters less than the habit.
sentences.zh: 金额没有习惯本身重要。

sentences.en: A small emergency fund can turn a disaster into a bad day.
sentences.zh: 一笔小小的应急金，能把一场灾难变成一个倒霉的日子。

sentences.en: Money is a tool for freedom, not a score to show others.
sentences.zh: 钱是通向自由的工具，不是给别人看的分数。

sentences.en: Start with what you can, and let time do the rest.
sentences.zh: 从你能做到的开始，剩下的交给时间。

sentences.en: Most of us put off small tasks until they become big ones.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都把小任务拖成大任务。

sentences.en: A reply, a form, a phone call: each takes only a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 回一条消息、填一张表、打一个电话，每件只要几分钟。

sentences.en: The two-minute rule says that if a task takes less than two minutes, do it now.
sentences.zh: 「两分钟法则」是说：一件事不到两分钟就能做完，就立刻做。

sentences.en: The point is not speed, but emptying your mind of small worries.
sentences.zh: 重点不是速度，而是把心里那些小牵挂清空。

sentences.en: A clear mind has room for work that actually matters.
sentences.zh: 心里清爽了，才有地方放真正重要的事。

sentences.en: Maps tell us the fastest way, but not always the most interesting one.
sentences.zh: 地图告诉我们最快的路，却不一定是最有意思的路。

sentences.en: In a new city, try walking without a destination for half an hour.
sentences.zh: 在一座陌生的城市，试着不带目的地走上半小时。

sentences.en: You may find a small bookshop, a quiet square, or a cook who tells you what to eat.
sentences.zh: 你可能会遇到一家小书店、一个安静的广场，或者一位告诉你该吃什么的厨师。

sentences.en: Getting lost is a way of paying attention.
sentences.zh: 迷路，是一种专注的方式。

sentences.en: The best memories are usually the ones we did not plan.
sentences.zh: 最好的回忆，往往是我们没计划过的那些。

passages.title: Why Songs Get Stuck in Your Head

sentences.en: Almost everyone has had a song repeat in their head for hours.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个人都经历过一首歌在脑子里循环好几个小时。

sentences.en: Scientists call this an earworm, and it is surprisingly common.
sentences.zh: 科学家管这叫「耳虫」，而且它出奇地常见。

sentences.en: Short, simple melodies with a little surprise are the most likely to stick.
sentences.zh: 短小、简单、又带一点意外的旋律，最容易粘住。

sentences.en: The mind repeats what it cannot quite finish.
sentences.zh: 大脑会重复那些它没能完全结束的东西。

sentences.en: So if a song will not leave, try singing it all the way to the end.
sentences.zh: 所以如果一首歌赶不走，试着把它从头到尾完整唱一遍。

sentences.en: A team without disagreement is often a team that is not thinking.
sentences.zh: 一个没有分歧的团队，往往是一个没在思考的团队。

sentences.en: The question is not whether people disagree, but how they do it.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于大家有没有不同意见，而在于怎么表达。

sentences.en: Good teams attack the problem, not the person who raised it.
sentences.zh: 好的团队攻击问题本身，而不是提出问题的人。

sentences.en: They ask questions before they defend their own idea.
sentences.zh: 他们会先提问，再为自己的想法辩护。

sentences.en: Trust grows when people feel safe enough to say "I might be wrong".
sentences.zh: 当人敢说「我可能错了」，信任才会长出来。

sentences.en: This summer, some places had floods while others had no rain for weeks.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，有些地方发洪水，另一些地方几周没下雨。

sentences.en: A warmer atmosphere holds more water, so rain falls harder when it comes.
sentences.zh: 更暖的大气能容纳更多水汽，所以一下雨就更猛。

sentences.en: Scientists are careful: no single storm proves the climate is changing.
sentences.zh: 科学家很谨慎：单独一场风暴不能证明气候在变。

sentences.en: But the pattern over many years is clear.
sentences.zh: 但许多年累积下来的趋势是清楚的。

sentences.en: What we do this decade will decide what the next one feels like.
sentences.zh: 这十年我们怎么做，会决定下个十年是什么样子。

sentences.en: Many people say they write only when they already know what to say.
sentences.zh: 很多人说，他们只在已经想清楚的时候才写。

sentences.en: In fact, writing is how you find out what you think.
sentences.zh: 事实上，写作正是你发现自己想法的过程。

sentences.en: A sentence on paper can show you a hole in your argument.
sentences.zh: 纸面上的一句话，能让你看见论证里的漏洞。

sentences.en: You do not need to be a writer to do this; a notebook is enough.
sentences.zh: 你不需要成为作家才能这么做，一个本子就够了。

sentences.en: Write for ten minutes without stopping, and read it back tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 不停笔地写十分钟，明天再读一遍。

passages.title: The Library as a Quiet Room

sentences.en: A library is one of the few places where silence is a shared rule.
sentences.zh: 图书馆是少数几个把安静当成共同规则的地方。

sentences.en: No one asks you to buy anything or to hurry.
sentences.zh: 没有人要求你买什么，也没有人催你。

sentences.en: You can sit with a book for an hour and simply think.
sentences.zh: 你可以拿着一本书坐一小时，只是想一想。

sentences.en: In a noisy world, a quiet room is a kind of luxury.
sentences.zh: 在嘈杂的世界里，一间安静的屋子是一种奢侈。

sentences.en: We often keep five windows open and finish none of them.
sentences.zh: 我们常常同时开着五个窗口，却一个也没做完。

sentences.en: Switching between tasks costs time and attention.
sentences.zh: 在任务之间切换，是要花时间和注意力的。

sentences.en: Try working on one thing for twenty-five minutes, then rest.
sentences.zh: 试着只做一件事二十五分钟，然后休息。

sentences.en: Doing less at once often means finishing more by evening.
sentences.zh: 一次少做一点，到晚上反而完成得更多。

sentences.en: A bad grade feels like a door closing.
sentences.zh: 一个糟糕的分数，感觉像一扇门关上了。

sentences.en: But a grade only describes one exam on one day.
sentences.zh: 但分数只描述某一天的一场考试。

sentences.en: The useful question is not why I am bad at this, but what exactly went wrong.
sentences.zh: 有用的问题不是「我为什么这么差」，而是「到底哪里出了问题」。

sentences.en: Failure is information, if you are willing to read it.
sentences.zh: 失败是信息，只要你愿意去读它。

sentences.en: Many people want to help but think they have no time.
sentences.zh: 很多人想帮忙，却觉得自己没有时间。

sentences.en: One hour a week is enough to make a real difference to someone.
sentences.zh: 每周一小时，就足以真正改变某个人的处境。

sentences.en: You do not need special skills to listen or to show up.
sentences.zh: 倾听和出现，不需要什么特别的技能。

sentences.en: Helping also changes the person who helps.
sentences.zh: 帮助别人，也会改变帮助者自己。

sentences.en: Eating alone is quick; eating together is slower and louder.
sentences.zh: 一个人吃饭很快；一起吃饭更慢，也更热闹。

sentences.en: A shared meal gives people a reason to sit down and talk.
sentences.zh: 一起吃饭，给了人们坐下来聊天的理由。

sentences.en: The food matters less than the time spent at the table.
sentences.zh: 吃什么，不如围坐在一起的时间重要。

sentences.en: Some of the best conversations happen between two bites.
sentences.zh: 最好的对话，常常发生在两口饭之间。

sentences.en: At night a city shows a different face.
sentences.zh: 夜晚的城市，会露出另一张脸。

sentences.en: Shops close, buses empty, and the streets belong to walkers.
sentences.zh: 店铺关门，公交空下来，街道属于散步的人。

sentences.en: Some people are just starting their work as others go home.
sentences.zh: 有人刚下班回家，也有人刚开始工作。

sentences.en: Walking at night can make a familiar place feel new.
sentences.zh: 夜里散步，能让熟悉的地方变得新鲜。

sentences.en: The fastest runner is not always the one who keeps going.
sentences.zh: 跑得最快的人，不一定是最能坚持的人。

sentences.en: A slow pace can last for years; a fast start often lasts a week.
sentences.zh: 慢一点能坚持好几年；冲得太快往往只坚持一周。

sentences.en: Compare yourself with yesterday, not with the person ahead.
sentences.zh: 和昨天的自己比，不要和前面那个人比。

sentences.en: The body rewards patience more than it rewards speed.
sentences.zh: 身体给耐心的回报，比给速度的多。

sentences.en: We know a film is not real, yet we still cry.
sentences.zh: 我们知道电影不是真的，却还是会哭。

sentences.en: A story gives our feelings a safe place to happen.
sentences.zh: 故事给了情绪一个安全的出口。

sentences.en: Music, faces, and a long silence do much of the work.
sentences.zh: 音乐、表情和一段长长的沉默，起了大部分作用。

sentences.en: Afterwards we often feel lighter, not sadder.
sentences.zh: 看完之后，我们常常觉得轻松，而不是更难过。

sentences.en: Leaving your phone at home for a day feels strangely quiet.
sentences.zh: 把手机留在家里一天，会有种奇怪的安静。

sentences.en: At first you reach for it every few minutes.
sentences.zh: 一开始，你每隔几分钟就想去摸它。

sentences.en: Then you notice the sky, the queue, the person beside you.
sentences.zh: 然后你注意到天空、队伍、身边的人。

sentences.en: Boredom, it turns out, is where new ideas start.
sentences.zh: 原来，无聊正是新想法开始的地方。

sentences.en: One morning the air is sharp and your breath is visible.
sentences.zh: 某天早晨，空气变利了，呼出的气看得见。

sentences.en: Summer ends without a meeting or a formal goodbye.
sentences.zh: 夏天结束，没有会议，也没有正式的告别。

sentences.en: People walk faster, hands in pockets.
sentences.zh: 人们走得更快，手插在口袋里。

sentences.en: Every season arrives quietly, then stays.
sentences.zh: 每个季节都悄悄地来，然后留下。

sentences.en: School teaches us to answer questions, but life asks us to find them.
sentences.zh: 学校教我们回答问题，生活却要我们找问题。

sentences.en: Few classes cover sleep, money, or how to say no.
sentences.zh: 很少有课讲睡眠、金钱，或如何拒绝。

sentences.en: These are skills we usually learn by making mistakes.
sentences.zh: 这些技能，我们通常是在犯错里学会的。

sentences.en: You can start learning them now, without waiting for a teacher.
sentences.zh: 你可以现在就开始学，不必等一位老师。

sentences.en: At school we speak one language; at home we may speak another.
sentences.zh: 在学校说一种语言，在家里可能说另一种。

sentences.en: A dialect carries jokes, food names, and ways of being kind.
sentences.zh: 方言里带着笑话、食物的名字，还有表达善意的方式。

sentences.en: Some people are shy about their accent, as if it were a mistake.
sentences.zh: 有人对自己的口音感到不好意思，好像那是个错误。

sentences.en: It is not a mistake; it is a second home.
sentences.zh: 那不是错误，那是第二个家。
